title: Only Good Vibes | KEY.co
description_expanded: Accommodating up to fourteen guests across five beautifully appointed bedrooms, the home offers both comfort and privacy, including a luxurious primary suite with a spa-style bath and soaking tub. A third-floor entertainment level adds to the experience with a game room, wet bar, queen-over-queen bunk, and a spectacular sun deck showcasing sweeping views. Outdoors, a private pool and lakefront setting create a serene escape, while thoughtful extras like six adult bikes, a six-seater golf cart, and parking for four vehicles make exploring effortless. Access to community amenities—including a fitness center, tennis and pickleball courts, pool, and playground—completes this exceptional coastal getaway just moments from local favorites and the sparkling Gulf. Perched along the tranquil shores of Sunset Lake with glimpses of the Gulf, Only Good Vibes is a stunning three-story coastal retreat just a short stroll from Destin’s famous white-sand beaches. Designed to capture the beauty of its surroundings, balconies on every level frame breathtaking lake and Gulf views while natural light pours through elegant French doors into the grand living space. Inside, plush furnishings and a striking stone fireplace create a warm yet refined gathering place, complemented by a chef’s kitchen featuring a large island, Sub-Zero refrigerator, wine fridge, ice maker, double oven, and six-burner Dacor stove. A spacious dining area overlooks the water, setting the stage for unforgettable meals and relaxed coastal evenings.
